name: govern
description: Governance planner (workflow plane): the Manage & Comply lane + QC/review. init-ledger gives an existing dataset a project.yaml (the brownfield entry point); dmp turns a Data Management Plan's promises into tracked obligations; ethics-track records IRB/IACUC protocols, expiries and amendments and surfaces renewals; preregister freezes a comparison's spec before execution; obligations tracks and resolves commitments; qc-review and stamped-assess report conformance and STAMPED coverage per dimension, scoring what they could not check as unassessed rather than zero. Commitments live in the ledger obligations[] and are provenanced via the datalad doer.
